xBRIEFInfo.description: Terminal and JSON reports for Autonomicon

narratives.Overview: Wire companion and analyze to emit Rich terminal reports and machine JSON. Successful runs always exit 0 even when findings exist. Analyze rolls chapter findings into one combined report. Stabilize JSON schema for Autonomicon. Traces: FR-RPT-1, NFR-2, NFR-3.
narratives.Acceptance: --format terminal and --format json work for companion and analyze. Exit code is 0 on success with findings. JSON schema documented and covered by tests. Combined novel report includes per-chapter finding groups.

narrative.Overview: Rich summary of findings by severity/category with locations.
Stable schema: manuscript path, mode, findings[], summary counts; Autonomicon-friendly.
Always exit 0 on successful completion; analyze aggregates chapter-by-chapter results into one report.

acceptance.derived_reason: derived 3 independently testable clauses from the task statement before product edit (#3323)
